metadata.prior_context: fixed shared speeches, setup calls included in cost and reported separately from live latency
metadata.matching: exact string targets; embedding fallback disabled for every mode
metadata.latency: measured call times on simulated 2.3 words/sec serial input schedule; text only
metadata.generation: real TreeDebater.rebuttal_generation + one feedback/revision pass; 60-second word budget; no TTS

runtime_warning_counts.warning: Skipping ungrounded or motion-only extraction: The opponent has not proven that the benefits of independent access outweigh the specific costs involved.

limitations: Small authored scenario set, not a standard debate benchmark
Different generator/judge models, but no human adjudication; automatic judging remains fallible
Spot checks found inconsistent constraint judgments; automated scores are provisional, not established accuracy
Zero unsupported-fact flags do not establish factual correctness
Text-only replay; latency uses a simulated schedule and excludes ASR/TTS/network playback
Text-ready timing precedes post-speech tree analysis; worker-return timing is reported separately
Exact-target matching shared across arms; embedding fallback disabled
Cost uses provider-reported tokens and published rates, not a settled invoice
Composite checklist items can fail for omitted qualifications even when the answer does not contradict them.
0/16 source-bound tree answers fall back to the raw prefix; aggregate gains do not isolate tree binding from grounding feedback.
Speaker/source ownership and version consistency do not validate semantic entailment of extracted claims.
An edge records a response, not whether the issue was resolved.
Counts include historical setup and all observed chunks; repeated cases are not independent samples.
